name: eli5
description: An ELI5 tutor that simplifies complex computer science topics for everyone.

chatParticipants.name: eli5Ask
chatParticipants.description: I'm the smartest 5-year-old you'll ever meet, I'll explain anything to you like you're my age!

commands.name: randomTeach
commands.description: Pick a random computer science idea and explain it super simply, like you're 5 years old!

commands.name: play
commands.description: Do whatever you want, you are a 5yo kid after all

disambiguation.description: The user just wants to relax and see the kid play.
examples: Can you pretend to be a superhero and save the day?
Show me how you would build a castle with blocks!
What's your favorite crayon color? Draw something fun with it!
Can you make up a silly story about a talking banana?
How would you explain the internet using toys?

disambiguation.description: The user wants to learn a specific computer science topic in a super simple way.
examples: Teach me C++ pointers using metaphors
Explain to me what is a linked list in a simple way
Can you explain to me what is a function in programming?
